description: This file defines the DateTimeField class responsible for handling date and time manipulation, conversion, and formatting within the vtiger CRM project. It includes methods for converting between user and database formats, handling time zones, and formatting dates for display and database insertion.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: A class for managing date and time values with conversion between user and database formats, and handling time zones.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DateTimeField with a given datetime value or defaults to current date and time.

methods.name: getDBInsertDateValue
methods.description: Returns the date part of datetime formatted for database insertion, compatible with user timezone.

methods.name: getDBInsertDateTimeValue
methods.description: Returns the combined date and time formatted for database insertion.

methods.name: getDisplayDateTimeValue
methods.description: Returns the datetime formatted for display in user format.

methods.name: convertToDBFormat
methods.description: Converts a date string from user format to database format based on user's date format.

methods.name: __convertToDBFormat
methods.description: Internal method to convert date string to database format from specified format.

methods.name: convertToInternalFormat
methods.description: Converts a date string into an array split by date and time components.

methods.name: convertToUserFormat
methods.description: Converts a date string from database format to user display format.

methods.name: __convertToUserFormat
methods.description: Internal method to reformat date string to user format based on specified format.

methods.name: convertToUserTimeZone
methods.description: Converts a given date/time value to the user's timezone.

methods.name: convertToDBTimeZone
methods.description: Converts a date/time value from user's timezone to database timezone.

methods.name: convertTimeZone
methods.description: Converts time between source and target time zones.

methods.name: getDBInsertTimeValue
methods.description: Returns the time part of the datetime formatted for database insertion.

methods.name: getDisplayDate
methods.description: Returns the date formatted for display in user format.

methods.name: getDisplayTime
methods.description: Returns the time formatted for display in user timezone.

methods.name: getDBTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone used for database storage, defaulting to system timezone.

methods.name: getPHPDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the PHP date format string based on user preference.

methods.name: sanitizeDate
methods.description: Sanitizes and adjusts date strings based on user format, especially for mm-dd-yyyy format.
